newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU finance ministers to meet on Sunday - Dutch govt.
newsitem.headline: EU finance ministers to meet on Sunday - Dutch govt.

text.p: The Dutch government said on Friday EU finance ministers and the European Commission would meet on Sunday for an informal working dinner on the eve of the two-day EU summit on Monday and Tuesday.

"The ministers of Finance of the European Union and the European Commission will gather on Sunday June 15 th at 9.00 pm...for an informal working dinner," the Dutch finance ministry said in a brief statement.

Asked whether the ministers would discuss the issue of a jobs resolution for the EMU stability pact, a ministry spokesman said he could not comment officially on the topics to be raised, but added "I think that would be obvious to everybody."
EU sources said earlier the Dutch EU presidency had called for an informal meeting of finance ministers on Sunday evening to discuss a jobs chapter to accompany the stability pact.
They said the gathering, scheduled for 1900 GMT, would also focus on the need for greater economic policy coordination among EMU members.
